name: polytope-laboratory
description: Offline mathematical workspace for 3D and 4D polytopes

scripts.engine:bundle: python -m PyInstaller --noconfirm --clean --onedir --exclude-module pytest --exclude-module matplotlib --exclude-module PyQt5 --exclude-module pandas --exclude-module IPython --exclude-module tkinter --add-data "../engine/__init__.py;engine" --add-data "../engine/formats.py;engine" --add-data "../engine/geometry.py;engine" --add-data "../engine/regular4d_validation.py;engine" --add-data "../engine/catalog_data;engine/catalog_data" --copy-metadata numpy --copy-metadata scipy --name polytope-engine --distpath build/engine --workpath build/pyinstaller --specpath build engine/server.py
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run engine:bundle && node scripts/prepare-package.cjs && electron-builder --win portable --x64
